brief: A three-storey tower: drawers on the bottom storey and open bins on the top storey.

requirements.evidence: Stacked bases at 0,0,0 / 0,0,1 / 0,0,2 plus adjacent cells -1,0 and 0,1 on all levels create a vertical column of three storeys (levels 0-2).
Three notch drawers on level 0: notch:0#-1,1#notch0, notch:0#0,-1#notch4, notch:0#1,0#notch3 (all hex-drawer-frame-notch variants) placed at bottom storey.

requirements.requirement: Open bins on the top storey
requirements.evidence: Open bins hex-bin-full at top storey: bin:0,0,2~hex-bin-full and bin:-1,0,2~hex-bin-full on level 2.

finish.summary: Three-storey tower built with bases at levels 0-2. Bottom storey has three notch drawers, top storey has two open bins. check_build ok, meshClash clear.

M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
